name: @pipeworx/mcp-country-news

tools.name: country_news
tools.description: The latest news about a country today, ranked by prominence (Google News): top current stories about China, India, Germany, Brazil or any other country, newest window first — not an unranked firehose. Optionally add a keyword query ("election", "floods") with a trailing day window, or read a section of the country's local Google News edition (WORLD, NATION, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, ENTERTAINMENT, SPORTS, SCIENCE, HEALTH). Returns ranked items with title, source publication, link and publish time.

country.description: Country name or ISO-2 code, e.g. "China", "DE", "Brazil".

topic.description: Optional: read this section of the country's LOCAL Google News edition (news for readers there): WORLD | NATION | BUSINESS | TECHNOLOGY | ENTERTAINMENT | SPORTS | SCIENCE | HEALTH. The edition is served in the country's own language, derived from the region (Germany -> German headlines, China -> Chinese, France -> French, Japan -> Japanese, Mexico -> Spanish); the response says which `language` was used. A country with no distinct edition in any language returns found:false reason no_local_edition rather than another country's stories (omit topic to get English news about any country).

language.description: Optional, topic mode only: force the edition language as a primary language code ("fr", "de", "en", "zh"). Needed for multilingual countries where the derived default is only one of several: Switzerland defaults to German, Belgium to Dutch, Canada to English, India to English. Ignored without `topic`.

query.description: Optional keyword combined with the country in the search, e.g. "election", "floods".

days.description: Search window: only items from the last N days (default 2).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-country-news forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the country-news pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
